_about: Fixed renderings of the site's own vocabulary, per locale. The draft script hands these to the model with every batch, and a reviewer changes a term here rather than in a hundred strings. A term with no entry for a locale is the model's call. Keep the note in English: it is the reviewer's brief.

fairminter.note: Counterparty's on-chain mint contract. A proper noun on this site.

mint.note: Verb and noun: paying XCP into a fairminter for tokens.

launch.note: One XCP-69 token launch, from announcement to pool.

graduated.note: The launch sold out and its pool opened. pump.fun's sense of the word.

refunded.note: The launch missed its soft cap and everyone was repaid.

scheduled.note: Announced, not yet open for minting.

upcoming.note: Chip on a scheduled launch's card.

soft cap.note: The 69M-token sale target. Keep the loanword.

LP burned.note: The pool's LP tokens were destroyed, so liquidity is locked forever.

holders.note: Katakana, as the Japanese crypto community writes it; 保有者 is the formal word exchanges use.

since mint.note: Return measured from the mint price.

all-time.note: The whole life of the market, as a window label beside 24h.

limit.note: Limit orders on Counterparty's order book (the nav label).

dispense.note: Buying XCP from Counterparty dispensers (the nav label).

rewards.note: The XCP Rewards programme for minters.

all-time high.note: Keep the Latin abbreviation the community uses; CMC Japan writes 過去最高値.
